pr_title: ESQL: Prevent overflow on SUM aggregation
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/110443

This PR does some things:
- ~~Add the `warnExceptions` capability to aggregators. Same as for evaluators.~~ This part was extracted to https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/111829
- Implement `warnExceptions` for `SumLongAggregator`
- Uncomment the long cases on `SumTests`, and adapt the tests

To be done:
- [ ] Retrocompatibility with older versions

# DO NOT MERGE
We can't merge this before the retrocompatibility with older versions is implemented, as we're now adding a new block to the intermediate state.

issue_context.title: [ESQL] Aggregations - return null values for individual buckets on errors
issue_context.body:
ESQL's design philosophy has been to avoid failing queries on errors as much as possible.  Scalars achieve this by trapping (expected) errors and setting their value to null for that row, with a warning.  Aggregations, however, do not currently do this.  Supporting null + warning for aggs has several steps:

 - [x] Make `Source` and `Warnings` objects accessible from within the generated aggregations code
 - [x] Extend the `@Aggregator` annotation to include a list of exceptions that should be turned into warnings, similar to `warnExceptions` on the `@Evaluator` annotation, and update the code generation to catch those warnings in the appropriate place
 - [x] Provide some means for aggregations to mark buckets as null.  This probably looks like a bitset column.

That last step will require a change to the Layout.  We currently have no capacity for evolving the Layout, which must be the same for all nodes participating in the query.  Solving that will likely be the bulk of the work in this ticket.

Finalizing a design for that is something we need to do within the ES|QL team.  If you're looking for a good place to get started contributing, I recommend picking a function off of [this list](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/98545) to implement.
